tasks.title: Session state machine and its transition table

acs.text: WHEN an event that the transition table allows arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL move to the state the table defines, and the table SHALL cover exactly the states idle, card, entering, expanded, detached, leaving and the events of the lifecycle.
WHEN an event that the table does not allow arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse it with a reason and leave the state unchanged.
WHEN the reader reports a context while entering THE SYSTEM SHALL reach expanded only if it is the context being entered (R9 step 4).
